page: Microsoft Azure E32s_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Esv6 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning operations. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations show strong performance in specific single-threaded and specialized tasks. The server achieved a strong rating in single-threaded gzip compression at 30.93 GB/sec and Geekbench single-core processing at 2001.0. Image processing at 15324.0 and text processing at 2541.0 also scored in the strong tier. Multi-core performance, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 15239.0 and stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 27932.88, falls within the average range. Notably, the Passmark memory score of 1595.09 is classified as weak, indicating a potential bottleneck in memory-intensive operations despite the large capacity.

For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier performance in text generation for small LLM models (135M) at 390.88 tokens/sec, while medium (7B) and large (70B) model prompt processing remains average. Static web serving throughput is strong at 54.65 GB/sec. Given the high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and dedicated CPU allocation, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads like database operations and caching layers, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external storage provisioning.
